There is no separate SuperGrok logo in these frames, only the written `SUPERGROK` label. The X mark at 21s is the X platform mark, not xAI.

### Root cause

The registered asset was already centred:

| Asset | Canvas | Alpha-ink bbox | Centre offset |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Registry `grok.png` | 1000×1000 | `[39,57,961,942]` | 0.0 / -0.5 px |
| Source `grok.svg` at 1000px | 1000×1000 | `[39,57,961,942]` | 0.0 / -0.5 px |

The generator put an 84px mark wrapper at `left:20px; top:20px` inside a plate with a 5px border. CSS starts those offsets inside the border, shifting the mark exactly 5px right and down. The cutout inherited the same defect at 0.92 scale.

The shared mark helper now supports animated marks directly at the plate centre, with visual-ink correction: `formats/cutout/lib/cutout_core.py:369`. The Grok wrapper was removed at `shorts_run14/gen/grokbuild_scene.py:772`.

Regression coverage is in `formats/cutout/lib/test_mark_ink_seating.py:1`. Grok, Claude Code, and X measured within 0.005px in Chromium, while the existing Claude Code and X helper HTML remained byte-for-byte unchanged.
